item.title: [My Lab] Writeup My Lab 1 (Java Deserialization, Python Sandbox Escape)
item.author: quactv
item.description: Overview Address: 10.14.140.127 This Lab was created for myself and everyone in my teamtontac to research and learn about security vulnerabilities and develop ourselves. 1 – Exploit the Java Deserialization vulnerability on port 8081 to get the datmom shell 2 – From datmom, escape the python sandbox to escalate to root. There are also some other services that act as rabbit holes (SQLInjection, SSTI). Rabbit hole Using a quick nmap scan we can see the service ports open on the server: Port 80
